ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional. A short label displayed above the section title.

SectionEyebrowColor.helper: Optional. Choose a built-in Bootstrap text color for the eyebrow.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. The main heading displayed above the card rows.
SectionTitle.placeholder: Everything your business needs to move forward online.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Supporting text displayed below the section title. HTML is rendered as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Describe what visitors will find in this group of cards.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. A short message displayed below all card rows. HTML is rendered as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Choose a solution to learn more.

SectionRows.label: Content Cards
SectionRows.helper: Add rows of content cards. Each row displays only its first three cards; additional cards in that row are ignored.

ContentCards.helper: Add cards for this row. One to three cards fill the row evenly.

Title.helper: Required. A short, clear card heading.

Description.helper: Required. Briefly explain the feature or destination.
Description.placeholder: Build, edit, and publish engaging content without needing a developer.

CardIcon.helper: Required. Enter a free Font Awesome class, such as fas fa-file-alt. The icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

ActionText.helper: Optional. Link text displayed at the bottom of the card. The link appears only when both text and URL are provided.

ActionLink.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a valid local or external URL.

Image.helper: Optional. Images display only when the row has one or two cards. Recommended minimum width: 1200 px.

ImageAlt.helper: Optional but strongly recommended for meaningful images. Describe the image for people using assistive technology; leave blank only when decorative.
